holdings.title: Holdings

manual.title: Registered holdings
manual.label: Registered
manual.empty: No registered holdings yet. Select an instrument to add one.
manual.detail: Select a quoted instrument, then enter where you hold it, its quantity and optional unit cost. Prices update from the source. Register holdings outside your synced accounts.
manual.summary: %{count} registered holdings included · prices from market feeds
manual.partial: Some holdings have no valuation yet. The total includes only priced holdings.
manual.invalidName: Enter a platform or account name, 1–80 characters without control characters.
manual.invalidNumber: Quantity must be a finite number greater than 0. Optional unit cost must be finite and at least 0; the resulting value must be finite.
manual.noQuote: Waiting for a price. Check the source connection and credentials.
manual.stale: Source unavailable or paused; showing the last received price.
manual.limit: At most %{max} registered holdings are supported.
manual.navHint: Published NAV in %{currency} per fund share. Enter fund shares, not the invested amount. NAV updates daily.
manual.gramHint: Enter grams and cost per gram. For a gold fund, select its actual fund code and enter fund shares.

holdings.emptyDetail: Register holdings from a supported market source, or open Settings to sync Binance, Bybit or OKX using a read-only API key.
